productWalkthrough.title: One base resume becomes one targeted application
productWalkthrough.subtitle: Follow the job-specific flow: upload your base resume, paste the job ad, clarify missing proof, align to the role and Saudi market, then prepare ATS-ready output and interview questions.
productWalkthrough.heroTitle: Tailor every resume to the job without inventing a thing.
productWalkthrough.heroSubtitle: Watheq helps you turn one existing resume into a targeted application for each job ad with job matching, clarifying questions, Saudi-market context, ATS improvement, and interview preparation.
productWalkthrough.heroNote: No fake experience. No generic rewrite.

productWalkthrough.ctaNote: Base resume, job ad, clarification, alignment, ATS, interview prep.

upload.title: Upload your base resume
upload.description: Start from the resume you already have. Watheq structures the real experience, skills, roles, and language that can be safely reused.

match.title: Paste the job ad
match.description: Watheq reads the job's skills, tools, responsibilities, keywords, and proof expectations so the tailoring starts from the specific role.

clarify.title: Clarify before rewriting
clarify.description: If a claim needs scope, numbers, or context, Watheq asks first instead of guessing, keeping the rewrite defensible.

vision.title: Align to the role and Saudi market
vision.description: Watheq connects your evidence to the role, Saudi-market language, and Vision 2030 priorities where they are relevant to the job ad.

optimize.title: Prepare ATS-ready output
optimize.description: Watheq combines your answers, matched keywords, and original evidence into targeted bullets and ATS-ready positioning without inventing experience.

interview.title: Prepare for the interview
interview.description: Use the same resume and job evidence to generate role-specific interview questions, STAR prompts, and focus areas before the call.

preview.originalBullet: Managed reports and helped the team improve performance.
preview.uploadMeta: Sections, roles, skills, and language detected
clarifyQuestions: What business decision did the reporting improve?
How many stakeholders used the dashboard?
Can you verify the time or cost saved?
preview.optimizedBullet: Improved: Built Power BI KPI dashboards for 9 stakeholders, reducing weekly reporting time by 35% and improving decision visibility.
preview.visionDescription: Identify where the role connects to Saudi growth sectors, localization priorities, and bilingual evidence already present in the resume.
preview.interviewTitle: Interview prep from the same evidence
interviewQuestions: Tell me about a dashboard that changed a business decision.
How did you handle competing stakeholder priorities?
Which Vision 2030 sector experience is most relevant here?
preview.interviewReady: Practice answers with the same claims used in the tailored resume.
